Usage: aeat app ledger import [OPTIONS] {path}                                
                                                                               
 Import bank statements or records into the accounting ledger                  
                                                                               
┌─ Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *    path      <path>  Path to the bank statement file or directory         │
│                        [required]                                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *  --provider        <auto|csv|ofx|qfx|xlsx|ex  Statement format provider.  │
│                      cel|n26|pdf|pdf-n26>       Recognised values: auto,    │
│                                                 csv, ofx, qfx, xlsx, excel, │
│                                                 n26, pdf, pdf-n26           │
│                                                 [required]                  │
│    --dry-run                                    Run the import in dry-run   │
│                                                 mode (without saving)       │
│    --verify                                     Verify entries after import │
│    --file            <path>                     Original file used to       │
│                                                 verify imported rows.       │
│    --verbose                                    Show detailed information   │
│                                                 during import               │
│    --period          <str>                      Filing period as an AEAT    │
│                                                 token: 1T-4T (quarters), 0A │
│                                                 (annual), 01-12 (months).   │
│                                                 Combine with --year to      │
│                                                 choose the year.            │
│    --year            <int>                      Filing year for --period    │
│                                                 (e.g. 2024).                │
│    --help                                       Show this message and exit. │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
